title: Restriction of a disjoint-open direct-image product
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I a small (Type 0) indexing type, U_i open subsets with the property that x in U_i and x in U_j imply i=j, and F_i O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix i and V contained in U_i. With tensor-formula pullback and module direct image [def-pc-module-pullback], the restriction to V of the product over j of (U_j -> X)_*(U_j -> X)^* F_j is isomorphic to F_i restricted to V. No cover or finiteness condition is imposed; empty opens and infinitely many factors are included.

proof.text: Identify tensor-formula pullback along an open immersion with the sectionwise restriction functor, by uniqueness of the left adjoint of direct image. Restriction preserves limits: after the conservative underlying-presheaf functor it is precomposition, which preserves limits. Use PreservesProduct.iso to pass from restriction of the product to the product of restrictions.

For j different from i, every open of V has empty preimage in U_j by disjointness and V contained in U_i. A module sheaf has just the zero section over the empty open, by uniqueness for the empty cover. Thus the restricted j-th factor is a zero object. Projection from a product with all other factors zero is an isomorphism; its inverse has identity component at i and zero components elsewhere.

Factor V -> X through U_i. The restriction/direct-image counit identifies restriction of the i-th factor to U_i with the original restricted F_i. Restrict along V -> U_i and use restriction composition to identify it with F_i restricted to V. Compose with the product comparison and convert back to tensor pullback.

lean.statement:
theorem disjointOpenProduct_restrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type}
    (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ (i j : ι) (x : X), x ∈ U i → x ∈ U j → i = j)
    (F : ι → X.Modules) (i : ι) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U i) :
    Nonempty ((tensorPullback V.ι).obj
      (∏ᶜ fun j ↦ (pushforward (U j).ι).obj ((tensorPullback (U j).ι).obj (F j))) ≅
        (tensorPullback V.ι).obj (F i))
